pages.title: How to Use
pages.text:
Ritual block that summons the Wild Warden Doll.

1. Place the Shrine anywhere
2. Right-click with an Echo Shard
3. One shard is consumed, the boss appears

Each shrine requires the previous boss dead before summoning again.

Defeat the boss for a chance to drop a Warden Doll Head. See "Wild Warden Doll" and "Warden Doll" entries.
